timeline.sql: SELECT tier FROM notebooks WHERE id=%s

SELECT b.id AS id,b.tier AS tier FROM notebook_bases e JOIN notebooks b ON b.id = e.base_notebook_id JOIN notebooks a ON a.id = e.notebook_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT NULLIF(CAST(%s AS text), '') AS uid) v WHERE e.notebook_id = %s AND b.id != e.notebook_id AND ((b.status NOT IN ('copying','deleting','importing','pending_delete') AND (b.tier = 'base' OR b.created_by = a.created_by OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants nge WHERE nge.notebook_id=b.id AND nge.principal_type='everyone') OR ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_members nm WHERE nm.notebook_id=b.id AND nm.user_id=a.created_by) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants ng WHERE ng.notebook_id=b.id AND ((ng.principal_type='user' AND ng.principal_id=a.created_by) OR (ng.principal_type='group' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members ngm WHERE ngm.group_id=ng.principal_id AND ngm.user_id=a.created_by)) OR (ng.principal_type='group_admins' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members nga WHERE nga.group_id=ng.principal_id AND nga.user_id=a.created_by AND nga.role='admin'))))) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_members xm WHERE xm.notebook_id = a.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants xg WHERE xg.notebook_id = a.id))))) AND (b.tier = 'base' OR (b.created_by=v.uid OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_members vm WHERE vm.notebook_id=b.id AND vm.user_id=v.uid) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants vg WHERE vg.notebook_id=b.id AND ((vg.principal_type='user' AND vg.principal_id=v.uid) OR (vg.principal_type='group' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members vgm WHERE vgm.group_id=vg.principal_id AND vgm.user_id=v.uid)) OR (vg.principal_type='group_admins' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members vga WHERE vga.group_id=vg.principal_id AND vga.user_id=v.uid AND vga.role='admin')) OR vg.principal_type='everyone'))))) ORDER BY CASE WHEN b.tier = 'base' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, b.name COLLATE "C", b.id COLLATE "C"
SELECT id FROM sources WHERE notebook_id=%s AND source_type NOT IN ('knowhow','memory') ORDER BY id

SELECT s.id FROM sources s WHERE s.notebook_id=%s AND s.source_type IN ('knowhow','memory') AND (s.source_type <> 'memory' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_items rm WHERE rm.id = s.memory_id AND rm.created_by = %s)) ORDER BY s.id

timeline.sql: SELECT notebooks.*, u.username AS _owner_username, COALESCE(ip.indexing_pipeline_id,'') AS _published_pipeline_id,COALESCE(ip.indexing_pipeline_version,'builtin.chunk.v1') AS _published_pipeline_version, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants ng WHERE ng.notebook_id = notebooks.id AND ng.principal_type IN ('group','group_admins')) AS _shared_to_groups FROM notebooks LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = notebooks.created_by LEFT JOIN unified_kg_state ip ON ip.notebook_id=notebooks.id WHERE notebooks.id = %s AND notebooks.status NOT IN ('copying','deleting','importing','pending_delete')
SELECT created_by, notebook_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM memory_items WHERE created_by=%s GROUP BY created_by, notebook_id
SELECT id FROM sources WHERE notebook_id=%s AND source_type = 'memory'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM sources WHERE notebook_id = %s AND source_type NOT IN ('knowhow','memory')
SELECT kg_mutation_seq,kg_reset_epoch FROM unified_kg_state WHERE notebook_id=%s

WITH total AS (SELECT object_type, status, COUNT(*) AS c FROM knowledge_objects WHERE notebook_id=%s GROUP BY object_type, status), memory AS (SELECT mo.object_type, mo.status, COUNT(*) AS c FROM knowledge_objects mo WHERE mo.source_id = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT s.id FROM sources s WHERE s.notebook_id=%s AND s.source_type = 'memory')) AND mo.notebook_id=%s GROUP BY mo.object_type, mo.status) SELECT t.object_type, t.status, t.c - COALESCE(m.c, 0) AS c, COALESCE(m.c, 0) AS m FROM total t LEFT JOIN memory m ON m.object_type = t.object_type AND m.status = t.status

SELECT b.id AS id, b.name AS name, b.tier AS tier, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_objects ko WHERE ko.notebook_id = b.id) AS has_kg FROM notebook_bases e JOIN notebooks b ON b.id = e.base_notebook_id JOIN notebooks a ON a.id = e.notebook_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT NULLIF(CAST(%s AS text), '') AS uid) v WHERE e.notebook_id = %s AND b.id != e.notebook_id AND ((b.status NOT IN ('copying','deleting','importing','pending_delete') AND (b.tier = 'base' OR b.created_by = a.created_by OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants nge WHERE nge.notebook_id=b.id AND nge.principal_type='everyone') OR ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_members nm WHERE nm.notebook_id=b.id AND nm.user_id=a.created_by) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants ng WHERE ng.notebook_id=b.id AND ((ng.principal_type='user' AND ng.principal_id=a.created_by) OR (ng.principal_type='group' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members ngm WHERE ngm.group_id=ng.principal_id AND ngm.user_id=a.created_by)) OR (ng.principal_type='group_admins' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members nga WHERE nga.group_id=ng.principal_id AND nga.user_id=a.created_by AND nga.role='admin'))))) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_members xm WHERE xm.notebook_id = a.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants xg WHERE xg.notebook_id = a.id))))) AND (b.tier = 'base' OR (b.created_by=v.uid OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_members vm WHERE vm.notebook_id=b.id AND vm.user_id=v.uid) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants vg WHERE vg.notebook_id=b.id AND ((vg.principal_type='user' AND vg.principal_id=v.uid) OR (vg.principal_type='group' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members vgm WHERE vgm.group_id=vg.principal_id AND vgm.user_id=v.uid)) OR (vg.principal_type='group_admins' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members vga WHERE vga.group_id=vg.principal_id AND vga.user_id=v.uid AND vga.role='admin')) OR vg.principal_type='everyone'))))) ORDER BY CASE WHEN b.tier = 'base' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, b.name COLLATE "C", b.id COLLATE "C"
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_objects WHERE notebook_id=%s) AS exists
SELECT kg_mutation_seq,kg_reset_epoch FROM unified_kg_state WHERE notebook_id=%s

SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM sources s JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 AS found FROM source_elements e WHERE e.source_id=s.id LIMIT 1) parsed ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT er.status,er.error_message FROM extraction_runs er WHERE er.source_id=s.id AND er.run_type='kg' ORDER BY er.created_at DESC,er.ordinal DESC LIMIT 1) latest_kg ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 AS found FROM knowledge_objects k WHERE k.source_id=s.id AND k.source_id!='' LIMIT 1) source_kg ON TRUE WHERE s.notebook_id=%s AND s.source_type NOT IN ('knowhow','memory') AND s.source_type <> 'promotion' AND (source_kg.found IS NULL OR COALESCE(latest_kg.status,'completed')!='completed' OR COALESCE(latest_kg.error_message,'') ~ 'windows_failed=[1-9][0-9]*/[0-9]+' OR strpos(COALESCE(latest_kg.error_message,''),'retry_incomplete=1')>0) AND NOT (COALESCE(latest_kg.status,'')='completed' AND starts_with(COALESCE(latest_kg.error_message,''),'kg objects=0 ') AND COALESCE(latest_kg.error_message,'') !~ 'windows_failed=[1-9][0-9]*/[0-9]+')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chunks WHERE notebook_id=%s) AS exists

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sources s WHERE s.notebook_id=%s AND s.source_type NOT IN ('knowhow','memory') AND s.source_type <> 'promotion' AND s.doc_type IN ('','academic_paper') AND s.parse_status IN ('extracted','extracting','parsed') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM source_paper_meta m WHERE m.source_id=s.id)) AS exists
SELECT * FROM kg_build_jobs WHERE notebook_id=%s ORDER BY created_at DESC,ordinal DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT nb.created_by AS owner_id,u.role AS owner_role FROM notebooks nb LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=nb.created_by WHERE nb.id=%s
SELECT upload_document_limit FROM user_profiles WHERE user_id=%s
SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key=%s

INSERT INTO conversations (id, notebook_id, title, created_by, created_at, updated_at) SELECT %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebooks WHERE id = %s AND status NOT IN ('copying','deleting','importing','pending_delete'))
SELECT question, payload FROM answers WHERE conversation_id = %s ORDER BY created_at ASC, ordinal ASC
SELECT search_profile_json FROM user_profiles WHERE user_id=%s

timeline.sql: SELECT (SELECT md5(string_agg(id, E'\x1e' ORDER BY id)) FROM sources WHERE notebook_id=%s AND source_type NOT IN ('knowhow','memory')) AS visible_digest, (SELECT md5(string_agg(s.id, E'\x1e' ORDER BY s.id)) FROM sources s WHERE s.notebook_id=%s AND s.source_type IN ('knowhow','memory') AND (s.source_type <> 'memory' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_items rm WHERE rm.id = s.memory_id AND rm.created_by = %s))) AS hidden_digest

SELECT t.id,t.title,t.mutation_seq,t.hidden_source_id,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowhow_rows r WHERE r.table_id=t.id) AS row_count,(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ch.seq),0) FROM knowhow_changes ch WHERE ch.table_id=t.id) AS enumeration_seq FROM knowhow_tables t WHERE t.notebook_id=%s ORDER BY CASE WHEN %s<>'' AND position(lower(t.title) in lower(%s))>0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,lower(t.title) COLLATE "C",t.id COLLATE "C" LIMIT %s

WITH catalog AS (SELECT t.id,t.mutation_seq,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowhow_rows r WHERE r.table_id=t.id) AS row_count,(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ch.seq),0) FROM knowhow_changes ch WHERE ch.table_id=t.id) AS enumeration_seq FROM knowhow_tables t WHERE t.notebook_id=%s) SELECT COUNT(*) AS known_tables,COALESCE(SUM(row_count),0) AS known_total_rows,COALESCE(SUM(mutation_seq),0) AS mutation_sum,COALESCE(SUM(enumeration_seq),0) AS enumeration_sum FROM catalog
